user.title: Västtrafik M34 Setup
user.description: Enter your Authentication Key from [developer.vasttrafik.se]({auth_key_url}). Find it in your application under 'Autentiseringsnyckel' (base64 encoded client_id:client_secret).

data_description.auth_key: The base64-encoded authentication key from your Västtrafik developer application. It combines your client_id and client_secret.

station.title: Search for Station
station.description: Search for your stop/station. Partial names work - try 'Central', 'Brunnsparken', or any part of the name.

data_description.station_name: Enter part of the station name (e.g., 'Central' finds 'Centralstationen')

select_station.title: Select Station
select_station.description: Select your station from the search results below.

data_description.station: Choose the station you want to monitor for departures.

mode.title: Choose monitoring type
mode.description: Choose whether you want a departure board for one stop or journey suggestions between two stops.

reconfigure.title: Configure journey
reconfigure.description: Change journey settings or choose new origin and destination stops.

origin.title: Where does the journey start?
origin.description: Search for the stop you are travelling from. You will choose the exact stop from the search results in the next step.

data_description.location: Enter a stop name, for example Lerum, or its 16-digit Västtrafik GID.

destination.title: Where are you travelling to?
destination.description: Search for the destination stop. You will choose the exact stop from the search results in the next step.

data_description.location: Enter a stop name, for example Göteborg Central, or its 16-digit Västtrafik GID.

select_origin.title: Choose departure stop
select_origin.description: Choose the stop where the journey starts.

select_destination.title: Choose destination stop
select_destination.description: Choose the stop where the journey ends.

journey_options.title: Journey settings
journey_options.description: Choose how many of the next trips to show and optionally limit the transport modes. Train types only apply when Train is selected.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Västtrafik API. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid authentication key. Verify you copied the full key from developer.vasttrafik.se.
error.no_stations_found: No stations found. Try a different search term or check spelling.
error.invalid_station: Invalid station selected. Please try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred. Check Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This stop or journey is already configured. Choose a different one or remove the existing entry first.
abort.reconfigure_not_supported: This configuration type cannot be changed here.

init.title: Configuration
init.description: Choose the type of monitoring you want to configure.

journey_action.title: Configure journey
journey_action.description: Choose whether to change the route or the displayed journey settings.

data.action: What do you want to change?

origin.title: Where does the journey start?
origin.description: Enter the stop you travel from. Search by name or enter the 16-digit Västtrafik GID directly.

data_description.origin_query: Example: Lerum, or a 16-digit stop-area GID.

destination.title: Where are you travelling to?
destination.description: Enter the stop you travel to. Search by name or enter the 16-digit Västtrafik GID directly.

data_description.destination_query: Example: Göteborg Central, or a 16-digit stop-area GID.
